verdict.rationale: Pilot is an accounting and bookkeeping service, so invoicing is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the only related evidence is a pricing-tier line reading "Full accounts receivable." Nothing documents founder-facing invoice creation and sending, online payment options on invoices, or tracking when invoices are viewed and paid. A bare AR service line item is adjacent, not the invoicing capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid
